{"metadata":{"description":"Telegram bridge for DeepSeek Harness: text, voice, photos and project-per-topic sessions without opening the desktop app","id":"gh:1432964548","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-tg-bridge","slug":"aleksvega/dsh-tg-bridge","topics":["ai-agent","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","telegram","telegram-bot"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Telegram bridge for DeepSeek Harness: text, voice, photos and project-per-topic sessions without ope"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ning the desktop app"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-tg-bridge"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Drive DeepSeek Harness from Telegram. It runs on the
machine that already has the harness, and it an"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"swers in the chat where you asked."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A forum topic is a project: its own session, working directory, model,
permissions and language. Two"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" topics share the install and nothing else."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Never made a bot? QUICKSTART.md goes from "no account" to a bot
that answers, one step at a time."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **A model per topic.** `/model` lists the routes the profile declares — provider
and model togethe"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"r — and a tap switches this topic only. `/model <route> all`
moves the default the other topics foll"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ow; `/model auto` hands the topic back.
A chat for thinking out loud and a chat for engineering no l"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"onger share one model.
- **A topic is a project.** `/cd my-app`, and every turn runs from that direc"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"tory —
on a permission-enabled profile the sandbox is narrowed to it too, so the agent
cannot write "},{"id":"p7s6","text":"outside the project.
- **One edited message per turn.** Steps, a timer and the cache hit rate, plus "},{"id":"p7s7","text":"the
reasoning in a collapsed block you can tap open. A long turn adds a second
collapsed block with "},{"id":"p7s8","text":"every tool call. `/stop` is a button on that message.
- **`/diff` — review the turn, one hunk at a t"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"ime.** The working tree is split into
files and hunks; every hunk gets two buttons: explain it, or r"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"evert just that
hunk. A button carries a hash of the hunk it was drawn from, so a press that
arrives"},{"id":"p7s11","text":" after the file moved on is refused instead of touching a line nobody was
looking at. `/diff stat` i"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"s the file list alone.
- **An endpoint from the chat.** `/endpoint add <id> <https://url/v1> <KEY_EN"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"V>
[model,model]` writes the provider without an AI turn, and the key itself is
never typed — only t"},{"id":"p7s14","text":"he name of the variable that holds it. The new models appear
on `/model` as routes.
- **Input: text,"},{"id":"p7s15","text":" voice, photos.** Any speech engine plugs in — a local script, any
command-line tool, or an OpenAI-c"},{"id":"p7s16","text":"ompatible API (see `docs/VOICE.md`)
— and the transcript is shown before the answer. A photo is read"},{"id":"p7s17","text":" by the turn's own
model through `read_image`, text and UI included; no second model is needed.
- **"},{"id":"p7s18","text":"Goal and checklist per topic.** `/goal`, `/tasks`; both survive restarts and
are prepended to every "},{"id":"p7s19","text":"turn.
- **Two scopes for every setting.** `/reasoning <mode> all` moves the default,
without `all` i"},{"id":"p7s20","text":"t moves this topic; language and pinning follow the same rule,
and `/crew use reviewer` gives one to"},{"id":"p7s21","text":"pic its own effort, permissions and agent
preset (four built-in sets, read-only, copyable).
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## First run"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"`setup.mjs` leaves a working bridge with these defaults, and none of them need
a decision before the"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ves a working bridge with these defaults, and none of them need
a decision before the first message:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Setting | Default | Where to change it |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| profile | `headless` | `/profile` |
| folder | the workspace you ran setup in | `/cd` |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- Node.js ≥ 24 (the version DeepSeek Harness ships; sessions are zstd-compressed)
- DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" `0.2.1-rc.2` or newer in the `0.2.x` line (`>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`)
- DeepSeek Harness installed (`~/"},{"id":"p13s3","text":".dsh/profiles/headless`)
- A Telegram bot token from @BotFather"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The supported harness range is declared in `engines.dsh`; that field decides
compatibility on its ow"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"n (DSH ignores `peerDependencies` when it is present).
The range includes an explicit prerelease bra"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"nch, because a plain `<0.3.0`
silently excludes `0.2.2-*` builds. A future `0.3.0` needs an explicit"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" bump:
the bridge relies on the `0.2.x` CLI flags and profile layout."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### What it needs from DSH"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The bridge is a client of the DSH CLI, and the surface it uses is small enough to
write down: `--pro"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"file`, `--json`, `--session-id`, `--expose-internals <cli.js>`
when the app binary runs the CLI, and"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" the `{"type": ...}` JSON events on stdout.
Profiles are read as files (`cordis.patch.yml`, `package"},{"id":"p16s4","text":".json`) under
`~/.dsh/profiles`. `package.json` spells the supported range out in
`engines.dsh`, and"},{"id":"p16s5","text":" it is capped below `0.3.0` on purpose: a minor bump may rename
an event, and a bridge that guesses "},{"id":"p16s6","text":"is a bridge that answers with silence."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Two escape hatches, for a moved app or a DSH that ships differently:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"`/doctor` prints the command a turn would actually run, so a machine where these
matter says so inst"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ead of failing with an empty answer."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"**As a DSH plugin** (the package carries a `dsh.bundle`; the catalog entry is
pending review):"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The plugin starts one bridge when DSH boots and stops it on shutdown; if a
bridge is already running"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" (for example from the scheduled task), it leaves it
alone. Run `npx dsh-tg-bridge@latest init ...` "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"first so a config exists."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"What `init` does:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| What | Where |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| bot token | `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` → `refs.DSH_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`; other keys are left alone "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"|
| your id and working directory | `~/.dsh/tg-bridge/config.json`; an existing file is not overwrit"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ten |
| `headless` profile | checked, with a hint on how to create it if missing |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"`init` flags: `--cwd <path>` (default `~/Projects`), `--voice` (enable
voice transcription), `--dry-"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"run` (show what would be written, change nothing)."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Optional provider settings live in `config.json`:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| Key | Meaning |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| `providerKeys` | extra env var names to pass to a turn, read from `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`; defa"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ult `[]` |
| `pricesUrl` | retired: `/prices` always reads OpenRouter's public list and labels the n"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"umber as a reference for the model |
| `vision.patch` | opt-in overlay profile for photo turns; defa"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"ult `""` — the turn's own model reads images |
| `vision.enabled` | set `true` to run photo turns on"},{"id":"p29s5","text":" `vision.patch` instead of the topic profile |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"The bridge is a single process with long polling. Each turn spawns a separate
CLI process that exits"},{"id":"p32s2","text":" after the answer, so "no DSH process" between
turns is normal, not a failure."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"- `config.json`, `state.json`, `pending/`, logs are in `.gitignore` and never
end up in the reposito"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"ry.
- The token is stored in the DSH credentials store, not in code or config.
- The bridge only rep"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"lies to ids in `allowedUserIds`."}],"truncated":true}
